_note: Gameplay on generated tracks (Phase 5 Step 3: track/events/, docs/TRACK_EVENTS.md). The money is the economy's (data/economy.json quests and trackEvents); these say which tracks there are and what's raced on them. events: the events a track gets when it isn't an official one (the day's, the week's, a quick race, a shared code), by its layout — each a quest type with its laps, start, rivals (count, skill range) and collisions; {track} in a name is the track's name.

daily._note: The day's track: the same for every player on the same UTC date. Its seed from the date (and salt); the preset by the seed from presets; the generator version fixed here (a newer generator doesn't change past days' tracks).

weekly._note: The week's track: the same for every player in the same ISO week (UTC), bigger and harder than a day's.

quick._note: A quick race: a random track from a preset (its rewards: data/economy.json trackEvents.byKind.quick, and capped each hour).

shared._note: A track from a code a friend shared: the same events as a quick race (and its rewards).

library._note: The track library (play/trackLibrary.js): how many recently played tracks and favourites are kept, the leaderboards' size.

reference._note: The AI reference times (track/events/reference.js): a headless lap at each skill level (data/npc.json skill.levels) by the class's reference car, when a track is first loaded, kept by code. cacheVersion: bumped when the AI or physics changes, so old times are made again.

loading._note: Entering a track from the real world: the fade, then the loading screen until the track is made (or loaded from the cache) and its reference times are known.
